message: 忘れられない思い出を

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, welcome. Come on in, come on in.」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte... That's a huge amount of luggage.」
D-Don't tell me she's planning to stay over and study......

name: Ria
message: 「R-Reference books, right~~. That just shows how super motivated Lolotte-chan is!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Let's do our best, Lolotte!」

name: Ria
message: 「She messaged saying she'll be a little late.」

name: Synn
message: 「...? I wonder why. Even though she's in the most trouble.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come on, come on! Every second counts, so let's get started right away!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, Synn-kun. Could I borrow your kitchen for a bit?」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't mind, but... what are you going to do?」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh!? U-Um, I was just thinking maybe I'd prepare some tea snacks for everyone~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I appreciate it. Still, don't you have to study, Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, and also! You're not allowed to come into the kitchen♪」

name: Misa
message: 「Well... with that said, let's get started...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come on, come on, Madam President! Time waits for no horse!」

name: Synn
message: 「Seriously, what have you been doing. Here, a drink」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't hand me milk, hand me water!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Madam Treasurer. Did she buy it properly, I wonder?」

name: Misa
message: 「Jeez, she's not a kid anymore. She'll be fine」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Doesn't that only happen when processing is fast?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Swap with Synn... No, no, I'll make a huge concession and swap with Misa!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Isn't that six of one and half a dozen of the other?」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, really. Well, in that case, fine.」

name: Synn
message: 「Aren't you all subtly escaping from reality?」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-This is just for a change of pace-wait, I'm not!」

name: Misa
message: 「Haaah... I really do get distracted easily...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Just bear with it a little longer. The surprise prank is almost ready.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, Ria-senpai... is taking a while. I wonder if she's having trouble with something.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because the President will get her foot caught on the floor and won't be able to move!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha. I make sure the fittings are well-maintained so anyone can move in anytime.」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Sakura-kun!! I don't get this problem here, so teach me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, let's see. Ah, for this part you just--wait, it's rare for Misa to ask me for help.」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't treat me like some rare beast!!」

name: Synn
message: 「How did I!? Besides, I feel like you could easily solve a problem like this, Misa.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Just as I thought. Well then, I'll be going」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Understood. I will go check on things in the President's stead」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Since the President's life is riding on this test, please focus on studying properly」

name: Misa
message: 「My, Nanaka-san, you don't even understand a problem this simple? Here, you see--」

name: Misa
message: 「There's no need to hold back, really」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Misa? Why art thou getting in my way...? It doesn't seem like she's doing it on purpose, though...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If she isn't doing this on purpose... then that makes it even worse...」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you two staring each other down?」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha--!? We were not staring into each other's eyes!」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you hiding something from me or what?」

name: Paqy
message: 「We're totally swamped with exams. Cut us some slack, man」

name: Paqy
message: 「Besides, this one's always been a weirdo」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, now, Nanaka-chan. Today's a wonderful day, so smile, smiiile♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh? If Senpai-san is here, does that mean--」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder what kind of amazing sweets are gonna come out, my heart's pounding」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha--whaaat!? What's going on, whose birthday is it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You still don't get it, ya blockhead? Tell me what today's date is.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Since the whole Student Council is here, we figured we'd throw a big, flashy celebration for once.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Well. Your parents are away on assignment, so... celebrating alone would be lonely, right?」

name: Everyone
message: 「Fro~m the da~y you were bo~rn, till today~ by e~veryone~♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Ta-da! And our birthday present for Synn-kun is... right here!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's the beefsteak you've been dreaming of!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A-Are you already full, by any chance? If so, I can----」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, no, no! It's just kind of different from what I imagined...」

name: Ria
message: 「Wouldn't that be pork? Commonly known as pork steak」

name: Misa
message: 「Come on. Eat it before it gets cold」

name: Synn
message: 「Kuh...... ugh, th-thank you for the foood!」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, that's about the reaction I expected」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now, now. You're a guy, so don't cry」
The best present everyone in the Student Council prepared just for me.

name: Paqy
message: 「You're an angel, so you can eat it whenever you want anyway」

name: Ria
message: 「The fun's gonna keep going just a bit longer, ya know. Right? Nanaka-chan」

name: Misa
message: 「That's pretty normal coming from you, Nanaka.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What's wrong with that? The President eats anything with gusto, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like I said, I wasn't cheaping out!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No... I'm just feeling a little emotional...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, up until now, they've always been like this」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yep, yep! This is the real deal. Well? Think you can finish it all?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nah. You already treated me to steak, so there's no way I can eat all this.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see, I see. Guess we've got no choice but to share it with everyone, then.」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, cake tastes better when everyone eats it together.」
Eating the steak I'd always dreamed of, and sharing a cake with everyone--a truly blissful moment.
I'm really glad I became the Student Council President.
Which is precisely why, before this position is put in jeopardy...

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaalright! Let's keep giving it our all after this too--!」
Studying for tests, which was supposed to be tough, ended up being super fun--
Time passes in the blink of an eye...

name: Misa
message: 「Haa... I wish time would just stand still」

name: Riesling
message: 「Milady, I have come to pick you up」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone, thank you so much for today」

name: Misa
message: 「It is the day a rival such as yourself was born, after all. Celebrating it is only natural」

name: Ria
message: 「Ufufu. I'm looking forward... to my birthday♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I want every day to be a birthday, yes I do」

name: Synn
message: 「Wahaha. If that happened, it'd actually stop feeling special」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew... Now then, shall I get started again~」

name: Synn
message: 「All of today's stuff. You're the one who arranged it, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see, I see. Of course it was! It's a present packed full of everyone's love, after all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't lose out, though, Nanaka! The present from me is gonna be the best! Sacchin said so too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Haaah... I really am glad I became Student Council President...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Um, Synn. Sorry to interrupt while you're soaking in the moment, but could you close your eyes for a sec?」

name: Synn
message: 「Okay or not... I don't really get what's going on」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N... No good... Kissing is too embarrassing, I just can't do it」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What was that for, all of a sudden」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Because you were grinning like an idiot the whole time. Thought I'd knock some spirit into you」

name: Synn
message: 「You're the one who needs to put some spirit into it, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'll be fine. I'm a girl who gets things done when it counts!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, you asked for it!? Alright, I'm going home to study. I'm gonna study my butt off! And wipe that smug look right off your face」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...\s03 Wh-what are you talking about, we do this every year!」

name: Synn
message: 「You really are my best friend, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn. Wanna try... closing your eyes one more time?」

name: Synn
message: 「No way. You're just gonna chop me again」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Right?! Totally! Anyone would think that, right? Ahahaha!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're the one grinning like an idiot, though」
Nanaka went home, laughing the whole way.
